description: This file defines the CandidateVacancy entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_job_candidate_vacancy' database table. It models the relationship between candidates and vacancies, including status and application date, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: CandidateVacancy
classes.description: Entity class representing a candidate's application to a vacancy, including status and application date, with ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the candidate vacancy record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the candidate vacancy record.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate object associated with this vacancy application.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate object with this vacancy application.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the Vacancy object linked to this candidate application.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy object with this candidate application.

methods.name: getAppliedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the application was submitted.
